list.name: series
list.label: Series
list.query: SELECT so.slug || '/' || se.metric FROM core_series se JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id ORDER BY so.kind, 1

list.name: grid
list.label: Grid series
list.query: SELECT so.slug || '/' || se.metric FROM core_series se JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id WHERE so.kind = 'grid' AND se.unit = 'W' ORDER BY 1

target.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', m.date, 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time,
       m.label AS text
FROM core_milestone m
WHERE m.date >= date($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime', '-1 day')
  AND m.date <= date($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch', 'localtime')
ORDER BY m.date

panels.title: $series — kWh per hour
panels.description: Energy integrated from stored samples only: power series are summed as value x duration, energy series are summed as-is. Hours the collector missed are short, not filled — read them against the coverage panel below.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(t, 3600) AS time,
       SUM(wh) / 1000.0 AS "kWh"
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) AS t,
         CASE WHEN se.unit = 'W' THEN s.value * s.duration_s / 3600.0 ELSE s.value END AS wh
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE so.slug || '/' || se.metric = '$series'
    AND s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: $series — observed time per hour
panels.description: How much of each hour the collector actually observed, from the sum of sample durations. A short bar in the kWh chart above is only meaningful once you know whether this bar was full. The trailing bar is always short — that hour is still in progress.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT $__unixEpochGroupSeconds(t, 3600) AS time,
       MIN(100.0, SUM(d) / 36.0) AS "observed"
FROM (
  SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', s.ts) AS INTEGER) AS t, s.duration_s AS d
  FROM core_sample s
  JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
  JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
  WHERE so.slug || '/' || se.metric = '$series'
    AND s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
    AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
)
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Grid import and export per day
panels.description: Local calendar days (not UTC), split by polarity: warm is bought from PG&E, cool is sent back. Days at the edge of the selected range are partial.

targets.rawQueryText:
SELECT CAST(strftime('%s', datetime(s.ts, 'localtime', 'start of day'), 'utc') AS INTEGER) AS time,
       SUM(CASE WHEN s.value > 0 THEN s.value * s.duration_s ELSE 0 END) / 3600000.0 AS "imported",
       -SUM(CASE WHEN s.value < 0 THEN -s.value * s.duration_s ELSE 0 END) / 3600000.0 AS "exported"
FROM core_sample s
JOIN core_series se ON se.id = s.series_id
JOIN core_source so ON so.id = se.source_id
WHERE so.slug || '/' || se.metric = '$grid'
  AND s.ts >= datetime($__from / 1000, 'unixepoch')
  AND s.ts <  datetime($__to / 1000, 'unixepoch')
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
